routines.semantics: Pushes the supplied module onto the CSPICE traceback stack; nested names appear in captured error trace. Empty names signal EMPTYSTRING. Blank/mismatched/overflow trace misuse emits diagnostic text rather than normal signaled exceptions.

scenarios.observes: chkin/chkout updates traceback stack without setting failure status; dispatcher invokes each actual raw operation. Scalars/complete strings reach StepOutput; captured signal short/long/trace and post-error flag reach recursive exact comparison against SpiceyPy. Named error cases require the matching diagnostic, not merely two failures.

Complete real captured traceback includes both active names before checkout; after explicit pops the next captured signal has no user frames. All short/long/trace fields and recovered flag reach the live exact comparison.

routines.edgeAssessment: Pushes the supplied module onto the CSPICE traceback stack; nested names appear in captured error trace. Empty names signal EMPTYSTRING. Blank/mismatched/overflow trace misuse emits diagnostic text rather than normal signaled exceptions. Cross-backend live workflows cover prepared/replaced messages, reset/repeated reset, post-signal recovery and/or visible stack effects as applicable. WASM allocation rollback is injected at all 14 allocation positions across the seven wrappers.
routines.errorAssessment: Empty-string or invalid-selector cases require stable error fragments. Selector restriction is a typed wrapper policy on both oracle and tspice. Trace mismatch/underflow/overflow diagnostics write to the disabled output device, rather than producing ordinary SPICE failures, so they are not misrepresented as thrown-error cases.
routines.fixtureRationale: No kernels or datasets required; all strings, nested module labels, and overlength ASCII messages are project-authored synthetic inputs.
routines.cleanup: Raw errors are captured/reset in the shared shim before throwing. Oracle capture obtains actual CSPICE messages/trace then resets in finally to model that documented policy. Case lifecycle calls kclear/reset before/after, clients dispose in finally, and each oracle workflow runs in its own process. Tests compare the next signal to detect stale state; WASM strings/output/error allocations are freed on every allocation failure. Trace entries are tracked per case and unwound in reverse order by a finalizer on success/failure; reset alone does not pop them. Direct same-instance tests check the next case has no leaked trace.
routines.tolerance: No numeric tolerance dependence: booleans, full strings, exact object keys/shapes and null effects compare exactly. Trace formatting is the shared CSPICE qcktrc output. No global or local tolerance changes.

findings.summary: Original success workflows compared null push/pop results plus a clean status; no assertion observed the stack effect, so no-op stack operations could pass.
findings.repair: Add success workflows that signal/catch the real raw error and compare the complete trace against SpiceyPy for nested, child-pop, and balanced-stack behavior. Capture rejects no-op signaling and unrelated exceptions.

findings.summary: The first full native lane failed nine new cases because active user trace names survived reset and leaked into later cases. WASM fresh instances and separate oracle processes hid that lifecycle gap.
findings.repair: Track successful chkin/chkout operations per case and unwind remaining entries in reverse order in a finalizer on both handlers. Explicitly balance successful workflows; test early-error cleanup with the next workflow on the same real backend instance.

node.trace: raw.chkin -> typed Node adapter -> registered native handler under global mutex -> tspice_chkin in shared errors.c -> chkin_c. Signaling captures/reset is the existing wrapper policy, not a harness substitute.

wasm.trace: raw.chkin -> WASM helper -> typed/configured _tspice_chkin with scoped heap allocations -> tspice_chkin in shared errors.c -> chkin_c. Signaling captures/reset is the existing wrapper policy, not a harness substitute.

routines.semantics: Pops the matching top module from the traceback stack. Balanced push/pop removes that name; popping a child preserves its parent. Empty names signal EMPTYSTRING; mismatch/empty-stack diagnostics are not ordinary thrown SPICE errors.

scenarios.observes: chkout removes prior chkin entry and keeps error status clear; dispatcher invokes each actual raw operation. Scalars/complete strings reach StepOutput; captured signal short/long/trace and post-error flag reach recursive exact comparison against SpiceyPy.
